releases.body:
## What's Changed

- Add the `./tui` package export required by opencode's npm TUI plugin loader.
- Bump plugin, MCP server, shared package, and lens runtime version to `0.1.2`.
- Document using the official npm registry for fresh MCP releases to avoid regional mirror lag.

## Packages

- `opencode-lens@0.1.2`
- `opencode-lens-mcp@0.1.2`

## Verification

- `bun test` passed: 28 pass / 0 fail
- `bun run typecheck` passed
- `bun run build` passed
- `npm view opencode-lens version exports dist.tarball --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/` shows `0.1.2` with `./tui`
- `npm view opencode-lens-mcp version bin dist.tarball --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/` shows `0.1.2` with the MCP binary


## Installation Note

If opencode reports only `Detected server target` for `opencode-lens`, remove the stale opencode package cache at `~/.cache/opencode/packages/opencode-lens@latest`, rerun `opencode plugin opencode-lens --global --force`, and restart opencode. A correct install reports `Detected server + tui targets`.

## What's Changed

- Make `instances_list` compact by removing historical session arrays from the default response.
- Add `sessions_list(instance, limit)` for explicit, bounded session history queries.
- Add a regression test to ensure instance discovery does not fetch or return session history.
- Update MCP server version reporting to use the shared lens version.
- Improve watchdog question alerts by falling back to pending `question` tool parts in recent messages.

## Packages

- `opencode-lens@0.1.1`
- `opencode-lens-mcp@0.1.1`

## Verification

- `bun test` passed: 28 pass / 0 fail
- `bun run typecheck` passed
- `bun run build` passed

releases.name: opencode-lens v0.1.0
releases.body:
Initial public release of opencode-lens.

## Packages

- `opencode-lens@0.1.0`: opencode TUI plugin
- `opencode-lens-mcp@0.1.0`: stdio MCP server for Hermes and other MCP clients

## Highlights

- Discover active opencode TUI instances
- Read current TUI session/status
- Send prompts to specific sessions
- Per-message model selection with `providerID` + `modelID`
- Read messages, diffs, and todo state
- Bridge interactive questions through MCP
- Respond to permission prompts with allow once / allow always / deny
- Switch visible TUI sessions
- Close accidental TUI overlays such as the model selector
- Optional watchdog scripts for permission/question/completion notifications
- Hermes skill included

## Installation

### opencode TUI plugin

Add to `~/.config/opencode/tui.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/tui.json",
  "plugin": ["opencode-lens"]
}
```

Restart opencode. opencode will resolve and cache the npm plugin package.

### Hermes MCP server

Use `npx`:

```yaml
mcp_servers:
  opencode-lens:
    command: npx
    args:
      - -y
      - opencode-lens-mcp
    enabled: true
    timeout: 30
    connect_timeout: 10
```

Or install globally:

```bash
npm install -g opencode-lens-mcp
```

## Verification

- `bun run typecheck`
- `bun test`: 27 pass / 0 fail
- `bun run build`
- npm clean install verified:
  - `opencode-lens@0.1.0`
  - `opencode-lens-mcp@0.1.0`
- MCP initialize + tools/list verified
